theory.title: Concesión y resultado: although, despite, however, therefore y as a result
theory.explanation: Usa although + sujeto y verbo; despite + sustantivo o forma en -ing; however para introducir una oración de contraste; y therefore/as a result para expresar una consecuencia.
theory.tip: Although + frase completa; despite + sustantivo o -ing.

patterns.label: Concesión y resultado: although, despite, however, therefore y as a result · 1
patterns.pattern: Although the bus was late, we arrived on time.
examples:
Although the bus was late, we arrived on time.
→ Aunque el autobús llegó tarde, llegamos a tiempo.

patterns.label: Concesión y resultado: although, despite, however, therefore y as a result · 2
patterns.pattern: Despite the rain, the volunteers continued working.
examples:
Despite the rain, the volunteers continued working.
→ A pesar de la lluvia, los voluntarios siguieron trabajando.

patterns.label: Concesión y resultado: although, despite, however, therefore y as a result · 3
patterns.pattern: The plan was expensive; however, it was successful.
examples:
The plan was expensive; however, it was successful.
→ El plan era caro; sin embargo, tuvo éxito.

patterns.label: Concesión y resultado: although, despite, however, therefore y as a result · 4
patterns.pattern: The river was polluted; therefore, swimming was banned.
examples:
The river was polluted; therefore, swimming was banned.
→ El río estaba contaminado; por lo tanto, se prohibió bañarse.

patterns.label: Concesión y resultado: although, despite, however, therefore y as a result · 5
patterns.pattern: As a result, more people used public transport.
examples:
As a result, more people used public transport.
→ Como resultado, más personas utilizaron el transporte público.

patterns.label: Concesión y resultado: although, despite, however, therefore y as a result · 6
patterns.pattern: Despite feeling tired, they finished the project.
examples:
Despite feeling tired, they finished the project.
→ A pesar de estar cansados, terminaron el proyecto.

patterns.label: Concesión y resultado: although, despite, however, therefore y as a result · 7
patterns.pattern: Although recycling takes time, it reduces waste.
examples:
Although recycling takes time, it reduces waste.
→ Aunque reciclar lleva tiempo, reduce los residuos.

patterns.label: Concesión y resultado: although, despite, however, therefore y as a result · 8
patterns.pattern: The campaign was well organised. However, attendance was low.
examples:
The campaign was well organised. However, attendance was low.
→ La campaña estaba bien organizada. Sin embargo, la asistencia fue baja.

patterns.label: Concesión y resultado: although, despite, however, therefore y as a result · 9
patterns.pattern: The road was closed; as a result, traffic increased.
examples:
The road was closed; as a result, traffic increased.
→ La carretera estaba cerrada; como resultado, aumentó el tráfico.

patterns.label: Concesión y resultado: although, despite, however, therefore y as a result · 10
patterns.pattern: Despite the difficulties, the community stayed positive.
examples:
Despite the difficulties, the community stayed positive.
→ A pesar de las dificultades, la comunidad mantuvo una actitud positiva.

content.passage: Although the town's recycling campaign faced several problems, it attracted strong support. Despite having a limited budget, volunteers visited schools and local shops. The first collection point was too small; however, the council quickly found another location. As a result, more residents began sorting their rubbish. The project is not perfect, but organisers believe that small actions can produce important changes.

items.prompt: Give an argument for using public transport although it can be slower.
items.modelAnswer: I think communities can make a real difference when people work together. In my area, there are several ways to improve the environment, such as using public transport, reducing waste and supporting local projects. Although change can take time, small actions often lead to better results. If more people took part, the community would become cleaner and healthier. I hope that by the next few years we will have made further progress.
